'''Barsus''' was a diminutive [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Near-Human]] who lived in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
During the [[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY|SoroSuub Anniversary celebration]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Barsus participated in a number of drinking contests in the [[Vanster Enan's Cantina (Tolea Biqua franchise)|Tolea Biqua franchise]] of [[Vanster Enan's Sop House]]. Barsus was able to win most of the contests by cheating, as he had an IV drip of purifying agents concealed in a pouch and connected to his femoral artery.<ref name="Blown Away" />

At some point afterwards, Barsus was present in Vanster Enan's Sop House in the city of [[Gadrin]] on the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], during the celebrations surrounding the [[Cularin Swamp Run/Legends|Cularin Swamp Run]], a local [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] event. He participated in drinking contests and used the same method of cheating as he had done on Genarius.<ref name="Peaces">{{LivingForce|Peaces}}</ref>
